pages.title: Cosmic Logic Wafer
pages.text: Etched with a lens made from a cosmic string, each trace on this wafer is a light-year long, folded into itself. It holds circuits on a galactic scale in a disc I can carry. The surface is dark, scattered with faint points like distant stars.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Quantum Lithographer I engraved a Hyperdimensional Wafer through Quantum-Dot Photoresist, focused by a loop of cosmic string. The string folded each trace across a light-year of space.
Made in $(item)Quantum Lithographer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Multiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Die, Unified Notes I, Warm Helium.
